Dana's message was just a heads-up, so I replied in a thread on her post in #north-team: "Thanks for the heads-up, Dana. Noted that your 1:1s are on Thursday this week. If you'd like me to check your calendar or send updated invites, just say so."

I haven't changed her calendar, sent any invites or done anything else, because she didn't ask for that.
